steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: I... can't believe it.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: I had signal interference active and everything. Even Closure's own latest drone gen wouldn't detect our location.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: What sensory tech is this power armor using?

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: I don't want to draw attention...

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Hold on tight, Doctor.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: 10% power, aim—

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Bingo.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Clear damage to right arm plating detected.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: No reduction in speed. Showed no signs of slowing when hit, either.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Who's in that suit? Do they not feel pain?

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Damage to left arm.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Damage to lower right leg.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Doctor, it's not reacting to the damage at all.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: If we want to stop it, I'll need to paralyze its power core in one shot—

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Come on, this makes no sense.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Even the most well-trained soldier wouldn't have this much tolerance.
You're right.
By mere fact of living, no individual can wholly suppress their most basic nervous responses.
A hand smashes through the power armor's core. Countless mechanical fragments burst out like fireworks, just as the blood of a fellow lifeform would.
With no time to waste, that hand pulls out.

The mecha-fragment extracted by her sheer force turns into dust, together with the pure white plating covering her five digits. It all drifts down to the floor, where it forms a paper-thin calcium crystal layer.
The power armor lies on the ground, the heat of its energy snuffed, a clean hole left through its torso.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: You—pierced that power armor's core barehanded?

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: That's a might of mights. And definitely a lot quieter than my defensive cannon.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Doctor, looks like the Bureau of, uh... Originium whatever won't be taking us in for attempted bombing today.

options: I do NOT want new criminal records for Rhodes Island.
I do NOT miss Columbian jail even a little bit.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: No need, Doctor, Mechanist.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: I'm the one getting Rhodes Island involved in Rhine's internal affairs—

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: I have a duty to ensure you don't come to any harm.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: Ferdinand was right on the money.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: Rhodes Island's people have already found Saria.

steps.name: Columbian Mercenary
steps.text: Should we maintain pursuit, ma'am?

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: If I stuffed you inside that power armor just now, do you think you'd survive?

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: Relax.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: Just a hypothetical.

steps.name: Columbian Mercenary
steps.text: Ma'am, no matter how powerful Saria is, there's only three of them.

steps.name: Columbian Mercenary
steps.text: We've got them way outnumbered, and outgunned with our secret weapon.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: Underestimate the enemy at your own peril.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: Haven't you been around Rhine Lab enough to learn? The punier a scientist looks, the harder she might just pulverize you.

steps.name: Columbian Mercenary
steps.text: Y-You mean that mechanist, or the professor-looking one with the hidden face? They can't be stronger than Rhine's Defense Director, right?

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: Rhodes Island... they've got talent for days.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: Let's go. I'm in love with that hypothetical just now, and I've got a few new ideas I want to try out.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: Good evening, Colonel.

steps.name: Colonel's Voice
steps.text: Clooney...

steps.name: Colonel's Voice
steps.text: Give me a rundown of what's going on at the site.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: Just minor boat-rocking... You know how hard it is for Pioneers to be satisfied, no matter how generous you get with their terms.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: Initiative is their strong point, and it forms the basis of Columbia's endless expansion, but sometimes it carries with it a little... hassle.

steps.name: Colonel's Voice
steps.text: So it's hassle. Unhassle it, then.

steps.name: Colonel's Voice
steps.text: I want to see the results you promised, not Rhine Lab in the gossip rags.

steps.name: Colonel's Voice
steps.text: Remember, you aren't the only tech company in Columbia.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: Understood.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: Rest assured, Colonel.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: Rhine Lab's products will not let you down.

steps.name: Frontier Team Member
steps.text: Sir, got a whole crew wanting out of this now.

steps.name: Frontier Team Member
steps.text: They say your plan's hopeless, that nobody's gonna listen to us. We can try everything we want, we'll never get our voices out.

steps.name: Frontier Team Member
steps.text: They're also asking who cares what Rhine Lab's up to.

steps.name: Frontier Team Member
steps.text: Like, we just need to get this work done sooner, get our money, move onto the next place and keep going.

steps.name: Frontier Team Member
steps.text: As for the guys who... went missing, well, their luck just ran out. The Pioneer Teams out in the deep wastes see a lot more dead every year than we do, anyway.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: I get it.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Tell them to just hold on a little longer. I'll bring our people back.

steps.name: Frontier Team Member
steps.text: So what's your plan?

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: I'm gonna head out for a bit.

steps.name: Frontier Team Member
steps.text: Out? Isn't... isn't that too dangerous?

steps.name: Frontier Team Member
steps.text: If the cops sent sharpshooters, they might just be waiting for you to come out.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Sounds like a good deal to me.

steps.name: Frontier Team Member
steps.text: Wh-What? You're keeping your head together, right?

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: A police sharpshooter, right? Might just be an old friend of mine. Crack shot with a crossbow. If this is how it's gotta be, it's not gonna hurt too bad.

steps.name: Frontier Team Member
steps.text: Sonny...

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Dr. Urbica, Doc Moore—

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: I need you to come out for a walk.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: You can drop the pretense. Do we have a choice here?

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Afraid not. Keep your chin up.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Once the folks outside get to see the score, maybe they'll change their minds, open up to taking our demands seriously.

steps.name: Rhine Defense Member
steps.text: Officer, we've got movement!

steps.name: Rhine Defense Member
steps.text: Drones, prepare to fire—

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: No. Hold your fire.

steps.name: Rhine Defense Member
steps.text: Officer...?

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: We can't hurt the hostages.

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: You, uh... Dr. Silence, over here.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Is there a development, ma'am?

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: Take a look through the binoculars. Are those your two colleagues behind S... the Pioneer?

steps.name: Frontier Team Member
steps.text: Sir—th—the comm lit up!

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Give it.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Knew it'd be you.

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: I could say the same thing.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: You, uh... you made rank, right? Didn't get the chance to congratulate you.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Who knew you'd stay at that precinct so long... You keep getting all this hassle from the frontier.

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: And I never thought you'd end up so... depraved.

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: You still remember any of the classes you took? Your law courses?

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: You still remember... the shit you said to me, the day I joined the force?

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: 'That's great! We'll be partners again. It'll be just like all those games we played as kids. We'll protect Columbia's peace, bring the bad guys to justice—'

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: Hah... how's that irony? You're bad guy number one right here and now.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Mary...

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: What's all that crap your boys are holding? Homemade weapons?

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: Drop those things before you embarrass yourselves any more.

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: You degraded yourself this far, but you still have an option. One final option.

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: Let those two innocent ladies next to you go.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: No. That's not in the cards for now.

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: Dammit. You're inching over the cliff here.

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: Sure, the government lets a criminal join the Pioneers if he doesn't want to do hard time.

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: But if... you break the law again out on the frontier? What charges does that buy you?

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: Answer me, counsel!

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Don't call me that, Mary, I'm begging you...

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: You're trying to guilt-trip me.

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: Yeah, I feel guilty now... guilty I let you go when you broke into my house. I should've hauled your ass straight to the station.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: That was a long time ago. I mean, I'd only just...

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: ...I'm sorry. I've always been sorry about that.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: But this time, I have a reason for doing all this. You have to hear me out, please.

steps.name: Frontier Team Member
steps.text: Sir!

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Frontier Team Member
steps.text: The doc, the doc, she...

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Doc Moore?

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: Configuration... error... entering... power save mode...

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Oh, shoot. Joyce...

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: What's happening to her, Doctor?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: You can tell. She's having an attack.

steps.name: Frontier Team Member
steps.text: What?! I—Is it Oripathy?

steps.name: Frontier Team Member
steps.text: C'mon, I got her! There's drugs for her, right? I... I can't do injections...

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: Ngh...

steps.name: Frontier Team Member
steps.text: C'mon, she looks like hell!

steps.name: Frontier Team Member
steps.text: I... I got this first-aid treatment band Rhine gave us. This does something for Oripathy flare-ups, right?

steps.name: Frontier Team Member
steps.text: I'll put it on her...

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: You're willing to give your own emergency care device to Joyce?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: If you hand her that band, your odds of survival go down significantly on the off-chance you get a sudden attack.

steps.name: Frontier Team Member
steps.text: The doc's been good to us all this time!

steps.name: Frontier Team Member
steps.text: I don't want anything to happen to her...

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: You say as the ones who kidnapped me and Joyce.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: We never wanted to do you dirty.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: I'm sorry... We're just a bunch of selfish nobodies.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Are the comms still going?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Ma'am, would you mind giving me permission to talk to the Pioneers?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: The Liberi experiencing an attack is my colleague, and my good friend.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: And more important still, I am her attending physician.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: I want to gather her situation from the Pioneers. Judging by their reactions, they clearly aren't unconcerned for her.

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: Go nuts.

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: But you don't have much time.

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: I just got orders from on high. If the Pioneers refuse to cooperate for another ten minutes, we'll cut all comms to the test site... along with all power to their living quarters.

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: Y—You'll cut the electricity?

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: Day-night temperature swings are massive in the barrens... They'll be freezing by midnight!

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: And there's several late-stage Oripathy patients among the Pioneers...

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: They need medical facilities to live!

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: I know.

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: That's what makes this a warning.

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: They need to know how serious Rhine and the police are here.

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: All their protests and demands have to be founded on a legal basis... Once they take the criminal route, nobody's going to hear them out.

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: But... aren't you friends with that Pioneer leader?

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: Friends?

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: The moment he abandoned himself, there was nothing left to say.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: How is she?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Real-time blood-crystal density's dropping. Eye movement indices are still highly irregular.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Eye movement indices?
Due to her Oripathy's focus lying in the brain.
Any fluctuation in her condition will impact her nervous system, cause her to fall into deep sleep, and go so far as to trigger epileptic attacks.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Huh? Who's there?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: The comms are still open.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Hello, sir.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: I'm Joyce Moore's attending physician. My name is Silence.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Doc Silence.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Firstly, I'd like to offer you my thanks.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Joyce's condition has only stabilized so quickly with your aid, and that of the other Pioneers.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: You're gonna thank us kidnappers, huh?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: In return, and please trust me when I say this, we really, truly wish to assist you.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: We still have five minutes before your comms, and power to your living quarters, are simultaneously cut—

steps.name: Frontier Team Member
steps.text: Sir—w—we've got a blackout!

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: It seems they've acted ahead of schedule.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Don't sweat it. I gotta appreciate you being willing to warn us.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: I gathered from ma'am Mary that you'd like a dialogue with Rhine Lab's upper management.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Can I ask why that is?

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: I wanna beg them to stop the experiments they're doing here.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: To what?

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: You're a good doc, same as Doc Moore here. But something tells me stopping a project this big's out of your hands.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Can you tell the Rhine Lab boss that this experiment is seriously, wicked dangerous?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Sir, do you have any proof?

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Even if I did, would you believe me...? A lone Pioneer at the end of his rope?

steps.name: Rhine Defense Member
steps.text: Officer, we're all set. We can cut the site's comms at any time.

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: Wait for Doc Silence to finish.

steps.name: Rhine Defense Member
steps.text: But the Director's demanding immediate...

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: Sorry, what police rank does your director hold? Remind me.

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: Tell fricking Ferdinand that saving people is my job. I'm not taking him on a ride-along here!

steps.name: Rhine Defense Member
steps.text: The Director's been in contact with the commissioner, Officer. They drew up this plan together.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Director... Ferdinand?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: I never imagined Defense would fall under Energy's purview.

steps.name: Rhine Defense Member
steps.text: Er...

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: If Ferdinand feels that Structural is his to rule too, then I would not mind resigning from Rhine Lab, effective immediately.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Joyce... Joyce!

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Is she... asleep?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: She's lost consciousness.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: If we don't get her treatment in time, she... she'll experience brain death before long.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Sir, I am preparing to enter the site now.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: I understand your concerns, so I would like to reassure you, I will not be carrying any weapons.

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: Don't do anything stupid, Doctor!

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: I know full well what I am doing.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Sir, I will not allow any police officers... nor Defense personnel to follow me.

steps.name: Rhine Defense Member
steps.text: Researcher Silence, I will report your conduct to the Director... Director Parvis.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: I am entering Test Site 359 under my status as a Rhodes Island Operator—

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: Me too...

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: —And my electrical engineering colleague will accompany me.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: We will provide medical services, free of charge, to the Oripathy patients on-site.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Not just for my friend, but for all of you.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: I do not care what choices Rhine Lab makes in the wake of this.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: I only know this—treating the Infected is constant to the Rhodes Island code of conduct.
